Mina — quick thoughts after reading the JD and candidate one-pager:

Leveling: the role as written straddles Senior/Staff. Key signals to push to Staff: owning cross-team serving latency improvements end-to-end, influence on runtime kernel selection decisions, and driving production rollouts for quantized variants. For Senior we expect deep ownership but limited cross-org influence.

Interview focus suggestions (2 bullets per interviewer):
- System Design (Jonas): large-scale inference pipelines, sharding & KV cache strategies; pass = designs an approach with clear tradeoffs for latency/cost and identifies three mitigation strategies for cache misses.
- Runtime & Kernels (Marissa): memory layout, quantization tradeoffs, and pegging cause for perf regressions; pass = explains root cause triage and suggests experiments to validate kernel changes.
- Product Serving Leadership (Laura): roadmap prioritization across latency vs cost vs model quality; pass = demonstrates a framework to quantify value of infra work and stakeholder communication plan.
- Evaluation & Quality (me): prompt sets, regression detection, and rollback criteria; pass = proposes concrete evaluation metrics and an experiment design for gating releases.

Bar-raiser role: Jonas to validate cross-cutting thinking and culture fit for ownership of production SLOs. If Jonas can't do the day, swap with Marissa but ensure someone with cross-org influence is present.

I'll update the interviewer_matrix.xlsx with pass criteria language.

Rishi
Staff Engineer, Serving
